annotations.title: Watch a company: its new awards, re-bids and notices

description:
What is new with one company (a competitor, a teaming partner, a prime), from the
    records, no AI: its new awards (base awards to it or a subsidiary in the last 45 days of
    loaded data, largest first; Defense publishes about 90 days late), its contracts ending
    within 12 months as incumbent (with the follow-on SAM.gov notice when one is posted: the
    re-bids to watch), and open SAM.gov notices in its main industries (its top NAICS codes by
    contract dollars in the last two fiscal years), newest first. On spendquery.com a signed-in
    user can follow the company and get these weekly by e-mail.
